notes: PLEA test run 4 on Sepolia (chain 11155111). Deploy PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor and PleaLaunch in this order, with zero ETH, in one atomic factory transaction. Only PLEA and PleaDistributor take privileged owner arguments, both $owner; PleaLaunch derives its owner from PLEA. CabalGate uses Intake v2 0xa43e6F75ee006411F79Ac1C84120606C2330DE82, oracle fee asset 0x44a1Cd38474FB1748400E7DEb5F8D786ccE3F89A, TestIMD 0x2B69099E59b05901faA1DD164fabf098bf831E82, signer 0x5598Aa9146215Bc13eb26f2c692Ad1461Fd32982, 18000-second seasons and a 118800-second dead-man. PleaLaunch uses Sepolia v4 PoolManager 0xE03A1074c86CFeDd5C142C4F04F1a1536e203543, the same TestIMD and oracle fee asset, Stacker 0x0457276D7b036818B3EddC1A4A3FCeda61e9314d, credit gas 1300000, START 1792162800 and mintOracleFee = 1 for Sepolia's 0.5 test oracle fee. Its final argument commits to keccak256 of this build's argument-free Letterbox creation code. PLEA.setLauncher accepts the deploy-transaction flag or PLEA's deployment block; atomic deployment prevents intervening registration. test/LaunchManifest.t.sol measures 12652544 launch gas including factory overhead, or 15436103 with 22% headroom, below the 16777216 transaction cap. After launch, anyone may deploy the ownerless Letterbox once through PleaLaunch.deployLetterbox(creationCode), which checks the committed hash and registers it with PLEA. PleaHook is deployed separately through PleaLaunch.deployHook(salt, initCode) with a mined flag-compatible CREATE2 salt and committed init code. PLEA supply remains zero until that deployment mints the fixed 87/3/10 split to the hook, Seasons and PleaDistributor. seed() opens trading for the owner any time or anyone from START. The accepted run-3 behavior is preserved with trader resolution from abi.encode(trader) hookData, then router msgSender() with 30000 gas, then a plain-wallet swap sender. Unresolved trades receive no cashback or buy record; unresolved surplus is burned in PLEA or retained for the pool in IMD; living-Cabal buys still require a recipient and the gate names the seller. Rebalance pays no keeper tip and deploys the retained reserve. Letterbox delivery caps the 0.35 IMD season-pot fee at actual sale proceeds; appeal fees may reach the appeal amount; PLEA uses Ownable2Step. APPEAL letters are clamped to the original plea's balance share using public CabalGate.pleaBalance, preserving the 20%/35% share bands and 50% ceiling. Letters escrow 20%; exact-output fee swaps retain the snapshot plus 10% cap, delivery retains the 95% sale minimum and 0.25 IMD runner tip, and other endings settle escrow. The owner is excluded from points, prizes and bonus; six seasons each allocate 5000000 PLEA and burn unpaid bonus. Judging definitions v2, all agreed economics and timings, display names, text views and the behavior-preserving gas pass remain unchanged. No Laureates.
